TARS PR #62 — WP-024 TODAY_SUMMARY_CANONICAL_DEDUPE review scope

Authorized intentional behavior change:

- sendTodayTransferSummary may prefer an existing pasCanonicalPaymentId, when present, as the financial projection dedupe identity so multiple confirmed observations of one PAS-authoritative payment contribute at most once to today's receipt count and total.
- Without pasCanonicalPaymentId, preserve the pre-existing fallback order exactly: normalized receiptIdentity first, then exact receipt identity.
- Distinct pasCanonicalPaymentId values remain distinct financial contributions.
- Canonical payment identity must not be inferred, synthesized or minted from receipt observation metadata.
- Receipt-index observations must remain preserved; this change is projection dedupe only and must not delete or rewrite observation rows.
- Existing source exclusions, room/date filters, amount extraction, count/total formatting and message behavior remain unchanged.
- Test-only coverage may add the bounded real-path sendTodayTransferSummary oracle and update the pinned canonical source hash mechanically; it must not expand product semantics.

Explicitly out of scope; review must BLOCK if introduced:

- PAS schema/service/transport/authority changes.
- AUTO/MANUAL confirmation-policy changes.
- W1/W2/W3 merge, repair/archive or other projection semantics beyond this isolated sendTodayTransferSummary correction.
- Migration/import/seeding/backfill or historical reclassification.
- Ledger/master-summary/payroll/report architecture changes outside sendTodayTransferSummary.
- OCR/Vision/provider/routing/UI changes.
- Workflow/deploy/cutover/production mutation.

Review must block any broader behavioral change than the bounded WP-024 sendTodayTransferSummary canonical-dedupe correction and its test-only CI support above.
